The Blood of Dawnwalker – The Choice
The Blood of Dawnwalker is a dark fantasy single-player action RPG set in 14th century Europe. The plot follows the life of conflicted protagonist, ‘Coen’ who is human by day, vampire by night, and the struggle of keeping his family alive. Players can uncover secret truths while exploring the vast open world where decisions shape the story.
